outcome: C-section rates in Europe and Romania
cohort: Pregnant women in Europe and Romania, with data from National Statistical Data (2009-2013), Official International Data, and birth registers from The Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology from the Clinical Hospital Sf. Pantelimon in Bucharest (2005, 2006 and 2014).
finding: There is a rising C-section rate in Europe and Romania, coinciding with an increase in median annual Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The rising number of C-sections is proportional to the rising dynamics of the median annual Apgar score.
